instructions_zh: 过去两周里，以下问题困扰您的频率是多少？

items.en: Feeling nervous, anxious or on edge
items.zh_draft: 感到紧张、焦虑或绷紧了神经

items.en: Not being able to stop or control worrying
Worrying too much about different things
Being so restless that it is hard to sit still
items.zh_draft: 坐立不安，以至于难以安静地坐着

items.en: Feeling afraid as if something awful might happen
items.zh_draft: 感到害怕，好像可能会有很糟糕的事情发生

scoring.missing: Platform conservative policy: all 7 scored responses valid 0..3 integers required. Any missing/invalid => no total or band; no imputation. This is not claimed as the authors sole missingness rule.
scoring.direction: 更高表示过去两周报告的相应困扰更频繁

severity.kind: Descriptive symptom-severity bands, not diagnosis or percentile norms
severity.source_locator: Original article Tables 2–3 and discussion, pp.1095–1096; PDF text extraction drops the leading 1 in one severe row, corroborated by Table3 and discussion.
severity.population: Original US clinical adult study, not Chinese norms.

screening.target: Possible generalized anxiety disorder for further clinical assessment
screening.scope: Original clinical criterion-validation sample only; no claim of accuracy for all users, Chinese translations or adolescents.

reference_profiles.norms: No population norms or percentiles approved.
reference_profiles.longitudinal: May describe within-person score changes with consistent form/language/recall period; do not claim a validated treatment response or minimal important difference from these packages.

reference_study.citation: Spitzer RL, Kroenke K, Williams JBW, Löwe B. A Brief Measure for Assessing Generalized Anxiety Disorder: The GAD-7. Archives of Internal Medicine. 2006;166(10):1092–1097.
reference_study.access_note: Six-page publisher article openly readable from University of Washington; Figure 1 p.1094 confirms original seven symptoms and extra unscored difficulty question. Freely readable is not an open redistribution license.
reference_study.article_reuse_status: LINK_ONLY: PDF explicitly says ©2006 American Medical Association, all rights reserved; no article PDF copied.
reference_study.evidence_summary: US study across 15 primary-care clinics; adult participants 18–95 years. Abstract reports 2,740, body 2,739 with no/minimal missing data; preserve this source discrepancy. Criterion interviews: 965. Threshold >=10 had sensitivity 89%, specificity 82% for GAD. Original severity tables: 0–4 minimal,5–9 mild,10–14 moderate,15–21 severe. Two-week symptom window does not establish diagnostic duration; original reference interview used six months.

runtime_policy.activation: Adult evidence external dossier only, not selected. No claim of Chinese validated cutoffs.

report.summary: 这份记录关注过去两周的紧张、担忧和难以放松等感受。它描述这段时间的经历，不给你贴上人格或疾病标签。
report.meaning: 数值较高，表示这些问题在你的回答里出现得更频繁。它不能单独说明原因，也不等于诊断。
report.everyday_example: 可以想想：最近有没有一件已经处理完的小事，仍在脑海中反复盘旋，让你难以放松？具体场景比一个分数更有助于把困扰说清楚。
next_steps: 记下一件最近最影响生活的具体情形，以及当时需要什么帮助。
如果这些感受持续或影响工作、休息和关系，可以与合格专业人员讨论。
report.limits: 这个中文工作译稿尚未经过心理测量验证，当前不启用人群分档。较少报告困扰也不能证明完全安全或不需要支持。
report.incomplete: 还有问题未完成，暂不计算总分；不把缺失答案当作没有困扰。
report.safety_unconditional: 本工具不是诊断或自杀风险评估，分数低也不能排除需要帮助的情况。若持续感到困扰，可寻求合格专业人员的评估。若正处于即时危险或无法保证自身安全，请立即联系当地急救服务，并寻求可信赖的人陪伴。此页面无人实时监测，不会自动联系您或安排援助。
report.attribution: Developed by Drs. Robert L. Spitzer, Janet B.W. Williams, Kurt Kroenke and colleagues, with an educational grant from Pfizer Inc.

Keep existing historical key and source wording; writer must assess release/version semantics.
No fresh translation, no new adolescent form, no ACT/CBT/DBT label.
Original impairment question is not a scored symptom.
